senses.definition: A bound contact TA stem for causing an admitted animate participant to accompany motion toward a contextual destination.

design: A regional suppletive class choice remains active when the object itself is Hebrew-derived contact vocabulary.

senses.definition: A contact adverbial indicating that all indexed members of a plural subject jointly participate in the same declared activity.

grammatical_features: The form is invariant in the first contact use.
It scopes over the complete preceding clause under one closed construction.

translation: It does not mean simultaneously in separate activities, in the same place, collectively as a noun, or all at once.
grammar: No comitative participant, reciprocity, coordination, or narrative relation is introduced.
design: Hebrew communal language directly frames regionally inflected ordinary predicates instead of remaining an ornamental gloss.
